question.text: A Cat III AIF receiving or making foreign investment must file the Foreign Liabilities and Assets (FLA) return by:

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 5.24 mandates the FLA return be filed by 15 July every year via the RBI FLAIR portal. The Trap: 31 March/30 Sep/31 Dec are not the prescribed FLA dates. Cross-Exam Context: Same filing applies across non-debt-instrument issuers. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Block 3-5 July internally for FLA preparation to beat the 15 July deadline.
